name: Products UI
description: UI components, hooks and stores for product management. Includes product list display with grid layout, product detail view, product card component, and state management for product operations with pagination and filtering.

components.name: ProductList
components.description: Displays a grid of products with loading states, error handling, and pagination. Includes product cards with view/edit/delete actions.

components.name: ProductCard
components.description: Displays a single product as a card with image, name, price, status badge, and action buttons

components.name: ProductDetail
components.description: Full product detail view with image, description, metadata, and edit/delete actions for owners

hooks.name: useProduct
hooks.description: Hook for managing single product state and operations (fetch, update, delete)
hooks.example: const { selectedProduct, fetchProduct, updateProduct, deleteProduct, isLoadingProduct } = useProduct()

hooks.name: useProducts
hooks.description: Hook for managing product list state and CRUD operations with filtering, searching, and pagination
hooks.example: const { products, fetchProducts, searchProducts, createProduct, updateProduct, deleteProduct, loadMore } = useProducts()

stores.name: useProductStore
stores.description: Zustand store for product state management with separate single product and list states
stores.example: const { products, selectedProduct, setProducts, setSelectedProduct } = useProductStore()

types.name: Product
types.description: Product interface with id, name, description, price, currency, image, active status, ownerId, and metadata

types.name: CreateProductInput
types.description: Input type for creating a new product

types.name: UpdateProductInput
types.description: Input type for updating an existing product

types.name: ProductListFilter
types.description: Filter options for product list (search, active, sortBy, sortOrder, limit, offset)

types.name: PaginationState
types.description: Pagination state with hasMore, total, currentPage, pageSize

types.name: ProductListResponse
types.description: Response type for product list API calls

ai.summary: Complete UI module for product management with components, hooks, stores and types. Includes ProductList grid component, ProductCard and ProductDetail components, useProduct/useProducts hooks for state management, and Zustand store for global product state with pagination and filtering support.
use_cases: Display product catalog in grid layout
Show product cards with images and prices
Handle product loading and error states

author: Bebarter Team
